title: The Bench Saved with a Mitten
youtube_title: The Bench Saved with a Mitten | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Anil is just outside the fun, close to a bench saved, or not, by setting a mitten there. Niko changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Anil has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
